title: Omar Feels Better
setting: A hospital room and a gym in the same town.

characters.name: Omar
characters.look: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron)

characters.name: Nina
characters.look: Nina (a woman of about thirty-five with short blonde hair and a white doctor's coat)

sentences.en: Omar wakes up and feels really tired.
sentences.zh: 奥马尔醒来，觉得真的很累。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron), without his cap and apron and in striped pyjamas, sits up in bed, yawning and rubbing his eyes.

sentences.en: He goes to see a doctor at the hospital.
sentences.zh: 于是他去医院找医生看病。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) walks into a bright hospital entrance.

sentences.en: The doctor checks his nose and his tooth.
sentences.zh: 医生检查了他的鼻子和牙齿。
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina (a woman of about thirty-five with short blonde hair and a white doctor's coat) looks at the nose and teeth of Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) with a small light.

sentences.en: "You eat too much sugar," the doctor says.
sentences.scene_prompt: Nina (a woman of about thirty-five with short blonde hair and a white doctor's coat) points to a bowl of sugar and sweets while Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) looks guilty.
sentences.draw_note: Shows the doctor pointing at sugar and sweets; her exact words can't be shown.

sentences.en: Walking is good for your body, too.
sentences.zh: 散步对你的身体也有好处。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) walks briskly along a park path in the sunshine.
sentences.draw_note: Shows Omar walking in the park; the advice that it is good for the body can't be shown.

sentences.en: Now Omar loves going to the gym.
sentences.zh: 现在奥马尔爱上了去健身房。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron), now in a grey tracksuit instead of his apron, lifts small weights in a gym and smiles.

sentences.en: He is thirsty, so he drinks lots of water.
sentences.zh: 他口渴了，所以喝了很多水。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron), in a grey tracksuit, drinks from a big bottle of water in the gym.

sentences.en: After good food, he relaxes and feels wonderful.
sentences.zh: 吃了健康的饭菜后，他放松下来，感觉好极了。
sentences.scene_prompt: Omar (a round-faced man of about fifty-five with a grey moustache, a flat cap and a white apron) relaxes on a sofa with a happy smile, an empty plate of salad on the table.
